reason: I need the part fast and I can't find it in Baghdad, but I won't hand my money up front to a name I've never heard of, not after my cousin lost her deposit to a page that disappeared. And two to three weeks is slow when I need it now.
objection: Paying for the item and the fee before anything arrives, to a new service with no one I know who has used it. If they vanish, the money is gone.
would_change_my_mind: If someone I know got an order from them, or if I could pay everything when it reaches my door. Then I'd try one small order.
